# Latin King Detailing

> Latin King Detailing is a 5-star rated professional mobile car detailing service based in Urmston, Manchester, UK. We specialise in mobile car washing, valeting, ceramic coating, paint correction, interior detailing and paint protection — delivered to your home, workplace or any location across Greater Manchester. No payment required upfront; we confirm your quote before any work starts.

## About

Latin King Detailing is one of Greater Manchester's most trusted mobile car detailing businesses. We are based at 426 Flixton Road, Urmston, Manchester, M41 6QT.

Unlike a traditional car wash or detailing garage, we operate exclusively as a fully mobile service — arriving with our own water supply, power and professional-grade products. Customers book online or by phone and we come to them, anywhere across Urmston, Trafford and Greater Manchester.

We have direct experience with everyday hatchbacks, SUVs, premium saloons, performance cars and exotic vehicles — including the Ferrari Purosangue and Ferrari 12Cilindri.

## Services

### [Mobile Car Valeting](https://www.latinkingdetailing.co.uk/services/mobile-valeting) — from £40
A professional mobile car valet and hand car wash alternative delivered to your door. Mini valet covers exterior wash, wheel clean and interior vacuum/wipe-down. Full valet adds hand-polish, leather or fabric conditioning and full interior trim. Available across Urmston (M41), Manchester and all covered areas.

### [Car Detailing](https://www.latinkingdetailing.co.uk/services/car-detailing) — from £120
Full car detail combining thorough deep cleaning, paint decontamination (iron fallout remover + clay bar), machine enhancement polishing and protective coating application — at your location.

### [Ceramic Coating](https://www.latinkingdetailing.co.uk/services/ceramic-coating) — from £350
Professional SiO₂ nano-ceramic coating that permanently bonds to the clear coat. Lasts 2–3 years, hydrophobic, UV-resistant and self-cleaning. Every ceramic coating package includes full decontamination and machine polishing prep. Suitable for hatchbacks, prestige cars and exotic vehicles.

### [Paint Correction](https://www.latinkingdetailing.co.uk/services/paint-correction) — from £150
Machine polishing to permanently remove swirl marks, fine scratches, water spots and oxidation from the clear coat. One-stage and two-stage correction available. Always followed by a protective coating.

### [Machine Polishing](https://www.latinkingdetailing.co.uk/services/machine-polishing) — from £80
Enhancement polishing with professional dual-action or rotary machines. Improves gloss and removes mild swirls, prepping paint for sealant or ceramic coating.

### [Interior Detailing](https://www.latinkingdetailing.co.uk/services/interior-detailing) — from £80
Deep interior clean using hot water extraction, steam cleaning and dedicated products for each surface type — leather, fabric, hard plastic, rubber and glass. Eliminates bacteria, allergens and odours at the source rather than masking them.

### [Exterior Detailing](https://www.latinkingdetailing.co.uk/services/exterior-detailing) — from £80
Foam cannon pre-wash, safe two-bucket hand wash, clay bar decontamination, machine enhancement polish and wax or sealant protection — all at your location.

### [Paint Protection Film (PPF)](https://www.latinkingdetailing.co.uk/services/paint-protection-film)
Self-healing polyurethane film protecting paintwork against stone chips, road debris, minor scratches and environmental damage. Optically clear and virtually invisible once applied. Compatible with ceramic coating.

### [Deep Cleaning](https://www.latinkingdetailing.co.uk/services/deep-cleaning) — from £200
Our most comprehensive package: full exterior detail, complete interior hot water extraction, engine bay tidy and finishing protection — all in a single visit.

### [Engine Bay Cleaning](https://www.latinkingdetailing.co.uk/services/engine-bay-cleaning) — from £50
Safe degreaser and steam engine bay clean at your location. Sensitive electronics protected throughout. No garage visit needed.

## Common Questions & Answers

**Q: Do you come to me or do I need to drive somewhere?**
A: We are 100% mobile — we always come to you. You never need to leave your home or office.

**Q: What areas around Manchester do you cover?**
A: We cover Urmston, Flixton, Stretford, Sale, Altrincham, Chorlton, Salford, Eccles, Didsbury, Timperley and more — 15 locations across Greater Manchester. Key postcodes: M41, M32, M33, M16, M30, M27, WA14, WA15, M20, M21. Message with your postcode to confirm.

**Q: How much does a car valet or car wash cost in Urmston?**
A: Mini valet from £40 · full valet from £80 · full car detail from £120 · ceramic coating from £350. All prices include our mobile attendance — no travel required from you.

**Q: How long does ceramic coating last?**
A: A professionally applied SiO₂ ceramic coating lasts 2–3 years with correct maintenance (touchless or two-bucket hand wash, no automated brush washes).

**Q: Do you detail sports cars and exotic vehicles in Manchester?**
A: Yes — we have hands-on experience with high-value and exotic vehicles, including the Ferrari Purosangue and Ferrari 12Cilindri. We select products and techniques appropriate for each vehicle's specific paint system and finish.

**Q: Can you wash or detail a satin or matte wrapped car?**
A: Yes — we use wrap-safe, wax-free products and the safe hand wash technique that is suitable for all specialist finishes including vinyl wraps, satin and matte paint.

**Q: What is the difference between a valet and a full car detail?**
A: A valet is a thorough clean — exterior wash, interior vacuum and wipe-down. A full detail goes further: decontamination, machine polishing, deep interior steam clean and protective coating. Valeting is maintenance; detailing is a full reset.

**Q: Do I need to provide water or electricity?**
A: No — we are fully self-sufficient with our own water supply and power. You simply need to provide safe outdoor access to the vehicle.
